Resolves #18680

Workstation now has two visual control rows: tour/theme above, live store statistics and Reset/Undo/Redo below. Undo and Redo keep their reactive step badges. Popup membership no longer adds controls. The toolbar-only observers, handlers, readout state and styling are removed; Group persistence and the underlying window commands remain.

Evidence: L3 achieved for the two-popup composition, history badges, theme rendering, Reset recovery and automatic persistence. Three inherited native lifecycle failures reproduce on unchanged `dev`; their comparison and owner are recorded in [the #17844 battery receipt](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/17844#issuecomment-5785084172). No new close-target residual.

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | `WorkspaceController.spec.mjs` checks exactly three controls and stable identities through membership changes. `WorkstationTopologyGroupsNL` opens two real popups and verifies the combined row keeps its height. |
| AC-2 | `Workspace.spec.mjs` preserves reactive Reset, Undo/Redo enablement and history badges. Native reclaim checks keep the same pane instance across Reset/Undo; the new toolbar witness reads the live history count. |
| AC-3 | Removed the controller's UI wrappers/membership observer and the root's readout-only hooks/state; save, open, mount, close and adoption APIs remain covered. |
| AC-4 | Native cold round-trip verifies automatic IndexedDB persistence without Save. Pop-out and Reset recovery pass; existing window API tests now invoke the retained commands directly. Inherited lifecycle reds are separately base-reproduced in the linked receipt. |
| AC-5 | README and Windows guide describe the compact controls and recovery boundary. Main-window screenshots with two popups were inspected in both themes; the updated Mermaid label was browser-rendered. |

## Deltas from ticket

The operator refined the composition to two rows during implementation. A wrapping container combines the existing status and topology views, with the toolbar background token exposing one shared skin. Change class: restoration.

Removing Open/Show removes their layout-preserving user interaction. Closed or cold-restored participants remain retained; Reset returns shipped panes to the default arrangement, while warm Undo can reverse a preceding tear-out. Layout-preserving open/mount remains programmatic. This change does not add automatic inline recovery or alter native lifecycle policy.

`agent-preflight`: not hosted here; the commit hooks passed. The shared baseline jobs provide the available CI gates.

### 🔬 Depth Floor

**Challenge — the ticket's premise is false for two user paths, and this PR inherits it rather than fixing it:** #18680 says native close and automatic persistence "already supply the intended interactions". At source they do not, for retained participants:

1. **Native close:** `VesselWorkspace#onNativeWindowRelease` keeps the participant `disconnected`, with its document, panes and history intact. On this head, `disconnected` is cleared in two places only. One is `mountTopologyWorkspace` (`WorkspaceController.mjs:148/152`), which was reached from the removed `Show … here` and from the window-connect path the removed `Open … as window` booted into. The other is `registerVesselWorkspaceTarget` (`VesselWorkspace.mjs:611`), which needs a window that connects.
2. **Reload:** persisted popup participants hydrate headless. No window opens without user activation, and nothing at boot calls `openTopologyWorkspace`; on this head its callers are programmatic only. The deleted arm `refusal has an inline recovery path` was the executable form of this guarantee.

After merge, a user who pops out two panes and reloads sees the main window without them. **Reset** brings them back but discards the arrangement. **Undo** helps only while the tear-out is still in session history. The PR body, `README.md:78-86` and the guide at `:194-201` state this boundary accurately. Emmy put the fork to the operator, and the reply addressed badges and row count.

**Operator decision at the merge gate:** accept that retained popups recover only through Reset or Undo, or ask for a road home. `hypothesis — needs V-B-A before implementation`: a gesture-free road home that adds no toolbar surface, for example a cold hydrate that presents retained participants inline. Emmy found auto-mount on native release unsafe, because warm reload shares that path. Cold boot is a different path, and it is unmeasured.
